SELECT COALESCE(SUM(shipping_minor), 0) * 1.0 /
       (SELECT CAST(value AS INTEGER) FROM shop_meta WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar')
FROM orders
WHERE placed_at >= '2026-03-01'
  AND placed_at < '2026-04-01';

reply:

FROM refunds
WHERE amount_minor > 250 * (
    SELECT CAST(value AS INTEGER)
    FROM shop_meta
    WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar'
);

       p.price_minor * 1.0 / m.value,
       (SELECT MIN(i.unit_price_minor)
        FROM order_items AS i
        WHERE i.product_id = p.id) * 1.0 / m.value
FROM products AS p
JOIN shop_meta AS m ON m.key = 'minor_units_per_dollar'
WHERE p.category = 'kitchen_dining';

WITH monthly_revenue AS (
    SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.placed_at) AS month,
           p.category,
           SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price_minor) AS revenue_minor
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN order_items AS i ON i.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products AS p ON p.id = i.product_id
    WHERE o.status <> 'canceled'
    GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', o.placed_at), p.category
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT month, category, revenue_minor,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY month ORDER BY revenue_minor DESC) AS revenue_rank
    FROM monthly_revenue
)
SELECT month, category, revenue_minor / (
    SELECT CAST(value AS REAL)
    FROM shop_meta
    WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar'
)
FROM ranked
WHERE revenue_rank = 1
ORDER BY month, category;

SELECT c.name,
       SUM(o.shipping_minor + COALESCE((
           SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_minor)
           FROM order_items AS oi
           WHERE oi.order_id = o.id
       ), 0)) / (
           SELECT CAST(value AS REAL)
           FROM shop_meta
           WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar'
       )
FROM customers AS c
JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id
WHERE o.status <> 'canceled'
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
ORDER BY 2 DESC, c.id
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    strftime('%Y-%m', o.placed_at),
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'delivered_complete' THEN
        COALESCE((SELECT SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price_minor)
                  FROM order_items AS i WHERE i.order_id = o.id), 0)
        - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(r.amount_minor)
                    FROM refunds AS r WHERE r.order_id = o.id), 0)
        ELSE 0 END)
    / CAST((SELECT value FROM shop_meta WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar') AS REAL)
FROM orders AS o
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

LIMIT 4;

       p.price_minor * 1.0 / m.value,
       MIN(oi.unit_price_minor) * 1.0 / m.value
FROM products AS p
JOIN shop_meta AS m ON m.key = 'minor_units_per_dollar'
LEFT JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.product_id = p.id
WHERE p.category = 'kitchen_dining'
GROUP BY p.id, p.name, p.price_minor, m.value;

    (SELECT CAST(value AS REAL) FROM shop_meta WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar'), 2)
FROM (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price_minor), 0) AS merchandise_minor
    FROM orders AS o
    LEFT JOIN order_items AS i ON i.order_id = o.id
    WHERE o.status = 'canceled'
    GROUP BY o.id
);

       (SELECT CAST(value AS INTEGER)
        FROM shop_meta

WHERE o.status <> 'canceled'
GROUP BY c.country;

SELECT p.category,
       SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_minor) * 1.0 / CAST(sm.value AS INTEGER)
FROM customers AS c
JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id
JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id
JOIN shop_meta AS sm ON sm.key = 'minor_units_per_dollar'
WHERE c.country = 'DEU'
  AND o.status = 'delivered_complete'
GROUP BY p.category;

WITH months AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT strftime('%Y-%m', placed_at) AS month
    FROM orders
),
revenue AS (
    SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.placed_at) AS month,
           p.category,
           SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price_minor) AS revenue_minor
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN order_items AS i ON i.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products AS p ON p.id = i.product_id
    WHERE o.status <> 'canceled'
    GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', o.placed_at), p.category
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT month, category, revenue_minor,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY month ORDER BY revenue_minor DESC) AS revenue_rank
    FROM revenue
)
SELECT m.month, r.category,
       r.revenue_minor / (
           SELECT CAST(value AS REAL)
           FROM shop_meta
           WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar'
       )
FROM months AS m
LEFT JOIN ranked AS r ON r.month = m.month AND r.revenue_rank = 1
ORDER BY m.month, r.category;

SELECT c.name
FROM customers AS c
JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id
JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id
WHERE o.status = 'delivered_complete'
  AND p.category IN (
    'kitchen_dining', 'outdoor_sports', 'home_office',
    'audio_gear', 'home_decor', 'kids_toys'
  )
GROUP BY c.id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.category) = 6;

ORDER BY 2 DESC, c.id
LIMIT 1;

SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.placed_at),
       SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'delivered_complete' THEN
           COALESCE((
               SELECT SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price_minor)
               FROM order_items AS i
               WHERE i.order_id = o.id
           ), 0) - COALESCE((
               SELECT SUM(r.amount_minor)
               FROM refunds AS r
               WHERE r.order_id = o.id
           ), 0)
           ELSE 0
       END) / (
           SELECT CAST(value AS REAL)
           FROM shop_meta
           WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar'
       )
FROM orders AS o
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

       p.price_minor / CAST(m.value AS REAL),

WHERE p.category = 'kitchen_dining'
GROUP BY p.id;

WITH category_revenue AS (
    SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.placed_at) AS month,
           p.category,
           SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_minor) AS revenue_minor
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id
    WHERE o.status <> 'canceled'
    GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', o.placed_at), p.category
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT month, category, revenue_minor,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY month ORDER BY revenue_minor DESC) AS revenue_rank
    FROM category_revenue
)
SELECT month, category,
       revenue_minor * 1.0 / (SELECT value FROM shop_meta WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar')
FROM ranked
WHERE revenue_rank = 1
ORDER BY month, category;

FROM customers AS c
JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id
JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id
WHERE o.status = 'delivered_complete'
  AND p.category IN (
    'kitchen_dining', 'outdoor_sports', 'home_office',
    'audio_gear', 'home_decor', 'kids_toys'
  )

SELECT c.name,
       SUM(o.shipping_minor + COALESCE((
           SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_minor)
           FROM order_items AS oi
           WHERE oi.order_id = o.id
       ), 0)) * 1.0 / (
           SELECT CAST(value AS INTEGER)
           FROM shop_meta
           WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar'
       )
FROM customers AS c
JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id
WHERE o.status <> 'canceled'
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
ORDER BY 2 DESC, c.id
LIMIT 1;

SELECT substr(o.placed_at, 1, 7),
       SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'delivered_complete' THEN
           COALESCE((SELECT SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price_minor)
                     FROM order_items AS i WHERE i.order_id = o.id), 0)
           - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(r.amount_minor)
                       FROM refunds AS r WHERE r.order_id = o.id), 0)
           ELSE 0
       END) / CAST((SELECT value FROM shop_meta
                    WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar') AS REAL)
FROM orders AS o
GROUP BY substr(o.placed_at, 1, 7)
ORDER BY 1;
